
`/ideas`, `/ideas/new` and `/ideas/$ideaId/edit` are the SPA's Ideas pages, replacing the templ placeholder `GET /ideas`, which is deleted with its `routeGuards` entry in the same change (WL-REQ-1305). `/ideas` is an `IdeaList` over `GET /api/v1/ideas`, so it shows the caller's own private ideas and every shared idea (WL-REQ-1799): title (a link to `/ideas/$ideaId/intake`), author, type, story type, status (`private` or `intake`, read-only), submitted, with row actions share (private ideas by their author only: a confirm dialog saying the idea becomes visible to everyone, then `POST /api/v1/ideas/{id}/share`), edit (to `/ideas/$ideaId/edit`, the caller's own ideas only) and delete (`DELETE /api/v1/ideas/{id}`). A private idea's row is marked as private. `/ideas/new` and `/ideas/$ideaId/edit` are one `IdeaForm` React component (title, type, body; story type and litmus test id shown only for a story pitch; no status field: a new idea is private) posting `POST /api/v1/ideas` or `PATCH /api/v1/ideas/{id}` and navigating to `/ideas` on success. It shows a refused write as WL-REQ-1811 says, asks before leaving with unsaved changes (WL-REQ-1812) and keeps a draft (WL-REQ-1813). The design prototype's schema-driven form engine (`/api/forms/*`, Ajv) is not ported: Ajv compiles with `new Function`, which `script-src 'self'` (WL-REQ-1304) forbids. When `LODE_INTAKE_PROJECT` is unset the pages work as described and the share action shows the 409's message as a toast.
